script_text: The cosmos just threw a curveball for Taurus this week. The Sun enters your 10th House of career Monday, sparking powerful ambition, but Mercury's square to Mars in your 2nd House warns against rash money moves early in the week. Wednesday is the turning point when Venus trines Jupiter in Cancer, unlocking your 11th House of hopes. This aspect fuels deep romance through your 5th House all week. By Friday, Mercury enters your 8th House revealing hidden truths about shared finances. Career opportunities surface Thursday through Sunday as Saturn's sextile to Mars keeps you strategic. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in Cancer, activating your 11th House of aspirations. Monday is your absolute worst day because Mercury squares Mars in your 2nd House of values. Channel your fixed earth element wisely and take decisive action on one meaningful goal. Follow for your daily updates.
